fact: MainOne, an Equinix company, announced in November 2023 the launch of its expanded open-access, carrier-neutral, Uptime Tier III standards data centre AB1.2 at VITIB, Grand Bassam, Côte d'Ivoire, following the initial data centre launched in 2019.
title: MainOne, An Equinix Company, expands Data Center footprint in Cote d'Ivoire
